title: Host Accounts Fee Schedule: Host Cancellation Penalties
content:
# Host Accounts Fee Schedule — Host Cancellation Penalties

This schedule sets the penalty figures that apply when a Host Accounts holder cancels a confirmed stay. The figures are the same for every host tier; they are listed tier by tier so that no tier is left without a published figure.

## Percentage of the penalty base, by timing band

| Host tier | More than 30 days before check-in | 30 days to 48 hours before check-in | Less than 48 hours before check-in | Lowest penalty | Highest penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| Standard Host | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| Superhost | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| Professional Host | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| Professional Host Plus | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |
| Enterprise Partner | 10.00% | 25.00% | 50.00% | USD 50.00 | USD 1000.00 |

The lowest penalty is the least charged on a penalised host cancellation; the highest penalty is the most charged on one host cancellation.

## Terms common to every tier

| Item | Term |
|---|---|
| Penalty base | The cancelled stay's nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total |
| Recovery | Deducted from the host's next payouts |
| Documented reasons for a waiver on an approved appeal | An extenuating circumstance; a guest violation (a guest's breach of house rules); a major disruptive event; a safety concern |
| Time to submit a penalty appeal | 14 calendar days after the host cancellation |

## Schedule notes

- The four documented reasons are the complete list of reasons for which a penalty is waived on an approved appeal.
- Hypothetical illustration of the floor and the ceiling: on a penalty base of USD 300.00 cancelled more than 30 days ahead, 10.00% is USD 30.00, which is below the lowest penalty, so USD 50.00 is the figure the schedule produces; on a base of USD 4400.00 cancelled less than 48 hours ahead, 50.00% is USD 2200.00, above the highest penalty, so USD 1000.00 is the figure produced.
